meta.parties: Ramanathan Chettiar v. Ibrahim Et Al

rules.statement: The Court has the power to fix the period within which money due under a mortgage decree is to be paid, or order such payment by instalments, either at the time of entering judgment or subsequently through section 12 of the Mortgage Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "In a mortgage action the Court, in entering judgment in favour of the plaintiff for the money due on the bond, has power to fix the period within which the money is to be paid or order such payment to be made by instalments. Under section 12 of the Mortgage Ordinance the Court has power, even subsequent to the decree, in giving directions for the sale to fix the period within which the money should be paid, so long as it does not alter or vary the original decree in that respect."
